audience: compliance and risk teams who review identity verifications and cases in Persona

useCases.title: Find inquiries by status, account or reference
useCases.text: The AI lists identity-verification inquiries filtered by status, account, reference id, template or created date, so you can count what is pending or failed.

useCases.title: Check the verifications behind one inquiry
useCases.text: The AI opens an inquiry and then its verifications, such as government-id, selfie or database checks, and summarizes the check results.

useCases.title: List open cases waiting for manual review
useCases.text: The AI lists cases filtered by status, account, reference, inquiry or report, and opens one to see what the analyst must decide.

useCases.title: Review screening reports and transactions
useCases.text: The AI reads reports such as watchlist or adverse-media results and transactions sent for fraud analysis, so you can look at flagged items.

useCases.title: Tag an account for review
useCases.text: The AI finds an account by reference id and adds a tag to it, for example vip, so the account is labeled for review.
